name: glycine
uses: INDICATIONS AND USAGE 1.5% Glycine Irrigation, USP is indicated for use as irrigating fluid during transurethral prostatic resection and other transurethral surgical procedures.
pediatric: Pediatric Use: The safety and effectiveness of Glycine Irrigation have not been established. Its limited use in pediatric patients has been inadequate to fully define proper dosage and limitations for use.
contra: CONTRAINDICATIONS NOT FOR INJECTION BY USUAL PARENTERAL ROUTES. Do not use in patients with anuria.
